cards.en: Subject particle · 가방이 있어요. There is a bag. / I have a bag.
cards.explanation: Marks the subject: the person or thing that exists or is being described.

cards.en: Topic particle · 저는 책을 읽어요. I read a book.
cards.explanation: Sets the topic: “as for this person or thing.” It can also show a contrast.

cards.en: Object particle · 동생이 이름을 써요. My younger sibling writes a name.
cards.explanation: Marks the object: the thing that receives the action.

cards.en: Location or destination · 친구는 학교에 가요. My friend goes to school.
cards.explanation: Marks where something is or where someone goes.

cards.en: Place of an action · 저는 도서관에서 공부해요. I study at the library.
cards.explanation: Marks the place where an action happens.
